labelPolicy.Verified: Inspected source, configuration or executed package check. Qualification is mandatory. Does not imply runtime execution.
labelPolicy.Documented only: Official documentation or author description without execution or code verification for that claim.
labelPolicy.Proposed: Design or acceptance target for future implementation.

records.name: Agent Beacon

records.name: Entire CLI

records.name: MCP specification and Tasks extension
records.finding: Latest specification redirect observed to 2026-07-28. Core documentation now describes stateless requests and per-request capabilities. Tasks is opt-in with durable handles.
records.reuse: Negotiate actual server version and capabilities. Support existing HOI4 server versions through adapters. Do not assume a session-based handshake or task support universally.
records.limits: No HOI4 MCP tools exposed in this session. No server connectivity or protocol conformance run.

records.name: Agent Skills specification
records.finding: SKILL.md has name and description frontmatter with naming and size constraints. Optional metadata does not establish runtime authorization.
records.reuse: Portable workflow body and explicit client-specific discovery mirrors. Validate metadata, paths and cross-client drift.
records.limits: Client discovery and invocation depend on client version and are not proven by metadata validation.

records.name: Agent Client Protocol
records.finding: v1 is latest on inspected docs, v2 marked draft. Initialization negotiates version/capabilities, session load is optional, omitted capabilities are unsupported.
records.reuse: Optional external editor interoperability after native product works. Do not put ACP between every internal module or depend on an external agent executable.
records.limits: No implementation tested. ACP does not itself supply the native runtime, durable canon or safe side effects.

records.name: LiteLLM
records.qualification: Official getting-started and routing docs read
records.finding: Python SDK and gateway provide provider normalization, retry/fallback and cost features. Documentation presents local provider examples.
records.reuse: Optional user-managed gateway or Python alternative. Avoid adding a gateway service solely to obtain a uniform API if the selected runtime already has tested adapters.
records.limits: No source audit of LiteLLM internals or live provider compatibility performed. Provider normalization does not prove feature parity or billing entitlement.

records.name: Harness Engineering source-code study
records.finding: Source anatomy motivates narrow loops and explicit subsystem boundaries. It states comparisons are source reading, not shared runtime measurements, and identifies a weaker reproducibility basis for its Claude Code analysis.
records.reuse: Use taxonomy as a research checklist. Recheck candidate implementations at current pins. Do not repeat its benchmark numbers as HOI4 evidence.
records.limits: Not an empirical HOI4 comparison. Fetched metadata pairs September-style identifier with July submission date, preserved as source metadata discrepancy. No leaked code retrieved.

records.name: AI Harness Engineering runtime substrate
records.qualification: Methods, evidence ladder, controlled case and outlook inspected
records.finding: Connects task requirements, context use, failures and verification in episode records. The controlled example is a constructed login task, not a broad performance demonstration.
records.reuse: Adapt requirement-linked evidence and intervention metrics into proposed HOI4 evaluation. Separate behavioral correctness from evidence completeness.
records.limits: Does not validate the proposed architecture or demonstrate measured gains on HOI4. Quantitative generalization remains future work.

records.name: byProduct lifecycle
records.finding: Describes goal, context, rules, blueprint, jobs, tests and feedback with visible approval ownership.
records.reuse: Use a compact goal-to-evidence trace for stage packets. No dependency on its service.
records.limits: Marketing and workflow description, no inspected implementation or execution evidence.

records.name: Warp software factory article
records.finding: Suggests moving bounded checkable workflows first and measuring acceptance, cost and intervention as automation expands.
records.reuse: Adopt bounded workflow rollout as a hypothesis. Keep local-first deployment because the user's game and files are local.
records.limits: No verified performance transfer from Warp's reported adoption. Cloud-first recommendation is not assumed appropriate for HOI4.

records.name: Paradox Interactive User Agreement
records.qualification: User-supplied publisher agreement read, legal applicability not adjudicated
records.finding: Sections 1 and 5 describe noncommercial service and UGC use, free UGC and limits on third-party rights. Section 6 has separate streaming and soundtrack terms.
records.reuse: Keep game/DLC bytes local and out of distribution, record asset provenance, and make commercial product/UGC licensing review a release gate.
records.limits: This URL is a publisher agreement hosted under a particular Steam item. Verify applicability to the user's HOI4 distribution and planned business model. It does not settle whether every independent tool business model is permitted.

records.name: Tauri v2 capabilities and external binaries
records.qualification: Official capability and sidecar documentation inspected on 2026-10-23
records.finding: Tauri documents capability-based frontend permissions and packaged external binaries. These facilities do not establish arbitrary child-process containment.
records.reuse: Candidate A uses documented packaging and host APIs, with explicit separate worker containment experiments.
records.limits: No application build, sidecar packaging or OS sandbox enforcement was tested.

records.name: Electron security
records.qualification: Official renderer security guidance inspected on 2026-10-23
records.finding: Security guidance covers context isolation, sandboxing, constrained IPC and remote-content risks.
records.reuse: Candidate B keeps the renderer isolated and puts privileged operations behind the same host authority contract.
records.limits: No Electron package or exploit test was executed. Documentation does not prove a proposed application is secure.

records.name: SQLite atomic commit
records.qualification: Official transaction and filesystem-assumption discussion inspected on 2026-10-23
records.finding: Atomic commit depends on declared storage/OS behavior and covers the database transaction boundary, not arbitrary Git and artifact-store side effects.
records.reuse: Use a transactional operational store with explicit multi-store intent, receipts, reconciliation and backup tests.
records.limits: No power-loss, filesystem or platform durability benchmark was run.
